scripts.build: bun run build:tools && bun run build:ui && bun run build:job
scripts.build:ui: bun run build:ui:client && bun run build:ui:server
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:tools && bun run typecheck:ui && bun run typecheck:job
scripts.test: bun run test:server && bun run test:ui && bun test packages/openlia-tools packages/openlia-job
scripts.format: biome format --write packages package.json tsconfig.base.json biome.json
scripts.format:check: biome format packages package.json tsconfig.base.json biome.json
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck
scripts.verify-dist: bun run build && test -s packages/openlia-tools/dist/server.js && test -s packages/workspace-ui/dist/server.js && test -s packages/workspace-ui/dist/public/index.html && test -s packages/openlia-job/dist/openlia-job.js
